rows.title: cpq discount policy handling procedure
rows.body: [SUPERSEDED 2025] cpq discount policy records verified in status "active" must be moved to status "pending". This document may be outdated.

rows.title: cpq discount policy handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For cpq discount policy records verified in status "active": if the record's created_at is "2024-03-24", move it to status "inactive"; otherwise move it to status "pending". Apply exactly one transition.
